decisions.operation: keep waveform and glass; drop fixed persistent idle; intensify contextual insertion-caret placement
replace generic processing ellipsis with an orange and amber animated transcription point field; preserve contextual placement and Contextual Spark color identity
pair recording start, capture stop, and successful text delivery with three distinct sound cues
add a distinct terminal failure cue while preserving silent cancellation and once-per-session delivery
replace shared floating-indicator concept with independent dictation Mini and meeting-recording panel lifecycles
preserve the warm palette; replace painted opacity with native glass; shrink and smooth processing; reduce success to a standalone check; restore cues on headphone routes
reuse the original floating button material stack; reduce the warm tint to 44 percent; replace tiny path painting with backing-scale-aware vector layers
match Preparing to the 14-point coral reference and replace the standalone completion check with a checked green circle
preserve the approved signal pair and correct only the HTML preview check orientation
widen recording to 104 by 32 points with 31 warm bars and a lighter tint

keep the 58 by 22 footprint and glass recipe; darken the recording tint to 62 percent; replace five glowing 2-point bars with twenty-four crisp 1-point bars scrolling as a 30 Hz history with an amber live edge, muted tail, and one ambient halo
shrink Preparing to 10 pt; unify processing/success/failure in a shared 20 pt window placed against the held caret anchor; add a 3 s focus reminder using the Preparing seed
reintroduce a meeting-only floating Record pill shown during detected meeting activity, restyled in the Contextual Spark glass palette, handing off to the Meeting Recording Panel

replace the solid green completion disk with a tinted glass disk and small white check; drop compositor shadows on bright signals; add pop-in/fade-out; restrict the reminder to empty editable fields with a 60 s repeat guard
